description: Secure MCP access to Onyx search, chat, projects, and administration.
name: io.github.ByWaleed/onyx-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Onyx API base URL, for example https://onyx.example.com/api
environmentVariables.name: ONYX_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Onyx Personal Access Token or API key
environmentVariables.name: ONYX_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Default Onyx agent ID for new chats
environmentVariables.name: ONYX_DEFAULT_PERSONA_ID

environmentVariables.description: Enable web search and allowlisted URL fetching
environmentVariables.name: ONYX_MCP_ENABLE_WEB_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hostnames permitted for HTTPS URL fetching
environmentVariables.name: ONYX_MCP_WEB_FETCH_ALLOWLIST

title: Onyx MCP
